scripts.server:install: python3 -m venv apps/server/.venv && apps/server/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r apps/server/requirements.txt
scripts.dev:server: sh -c 'if [ -f apps/server/.env ]; then set -a; . apps/server/.env; set +a; fi; export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings; PORT=${PORT:-}; if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then PORT=$(apps/server/.venv/bin/python -c "import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\",0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()" ); fi; echo "Daphne running on port $PORT"; cd apps/server && .venv/bin/python -m daphne -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT config.asgi:application'
scripts.dev:celery: sh -c 'if [ -f apps/server/.env ]; then set -a; . apps/server/.env; set +a; fi; export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings; cd apps/server && export PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" && .venv/bin/python -m celery -A config worker -l info --without-mingle --without-gossip --without-heartbeat'
scripts.test:server: sh -c 'cd apps/server && export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings; if [ -n "${TEST_REDIS_URL:-}" ]; then export REDIS_URL="$TEST_REDIS_URL"; fi; .venv/bin/python manage.py test __tests__'
scripts.test: turbo run test && apps/server/.venv/bin/ruff check apps/server && pnpm test:server
scripts.celery:tasks: sh -c 'if [ -f apps/server/.env ]; then set -a; . apps/server/.env; set +a; fi; export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings; cd apps/server && .venv/bin/python -m celery -A config inspect active'
scripts.celery:revoke: sh -c 'if [ -f apps/server/.env ]; then set -a; . apps/server/.env; set +a; fi; export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings; cd apps/server && .venv/bin/python -m celery -A config revoke "$0"'

scriptsDocs.server:install: 创建 apps/server/.venv 并安装 Python 依赖（首次开发必跑）
scriptsDocs.server:secret-key: 生成 Django SECRET_KEY，输出到终端后写入 apps/server/.env
scriptsDocs.dev:web: 启动前端 Vite 开发服务器（apps/web）
scriptsDocs.dev:server: 启动后端 Daphne（HTTP + WebSocket），自动加载 .env，未设 PORT 时随机端口
scriptsDocs.dev:celery: 启动 Celery Worker（模型压缩等异步任务），自动加载 .env
scriptsDocs.db:migrate: 执行 Django 数据库迁移
scriptsDocs.pyright: 对 apps/server 做 Python 静态类型检查
scriptsDocs.ruff:check: 对 apps/server 做 Python 代码风格/语法检查
scriptsDocs.test:server: 运行服务端 __tests__（需 Postgres；Redis 默认 127.0.0.1:6379，可用 TEST_REDIS_URL 覆盖）
scriptsDocs.test: 全仓测试：turbo 跑 web/core 单测 + ruff + test:server
scriptsDocs.build: turbo 构建所有配置了 build 的子包
scriptsDocs.celery:tasks: 查看当前 Celery 活跃任务
scriptsDocs.celery:revoke: 撤销指定 Celery 任务，用法：pnpm celery:revoke <task_id>
